source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Арефы и с ним 4299 мучеников (523).»

attestations.note: His life page there heads «День памяти: 24 октября» and no other day. The name link behind his place gives him an office the other calendars did not, «Арефа Негранский, градоправитель, мч.» — the governor of the city — and that is said in the life; this folder's `office` is left empty because the upgrade tool does not set it and a bare English rendering of «градоправитель» is a reading better made once for the whole wave. The company of 4299 the line keeps with him enumerates nobody, so it is one entry, as the other two calendars also have it.

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Αρέθας ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας και οι «σὺν αὐτῶ»»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2528/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: one of the leading men of the city of Negra in Ethiopia, killed when the Jewish king Dounaan took the city. **The companions of the line, οἱ «σὺν αὐτῷ», are named nowhere on the page**, so they are one entry and not folders — `docs/CORPUS.md` §10.1 as the brief applies it. The page dates the events by three reigns rather than by a year — «επί εποχής Ιουστίνου (518 - 527 μ.Χ.), Ελεσβάαν του Χριστιανού βασιλιά της Αιθιοπίας και Δουναάν του Εβραίου βασιλιά της Ομηρίτιδος» — and a `dates` object is proposed from that reign alone. Relics are listed at Dionysiou and the skete of Koutloumousiou on Athos and at Agathon in Phthiotis, the Taxiarchs in Aigialeia and Phaneromeni on Salamis; no coordinate is proposed. Its Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, is a proper naming him and is taken. **Its Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, is a common** — «Εὐφροσύνης πρόξενος ἡμῖν ἐπέστη, ἡ φωσφόρος σήμερον, τῶν Ἀθλοφόρων ἑορτή» names no saint at all — and is taken as his service under his own name, after BRIEF.md §4's ruling on commons; the Οἶκος, which does name him, is not a kind the schema holds. The same day's listing also carries «Αγία Γυναίκα και το Άγιο Βρέφος της», whose page says they were martyred with him; that pair is drafted as the new folder `holy-woman-and-her-infant` in batch el-10-24. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.11.2025 (24. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Арета.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4), URL year 2025 as `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. «муч.» is the `great-martyr` this folder holds — the Greek and Romanian both grade him great — and «градоуправитељ у граду Неграну» is the `office` it already carries, «Governor of the city of Nagran», confirmed word for word from a fourth book. `types` untouched. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND AN AGE REFUSED. The folder holds `death` 523 and the entry closes «Пострадаше и венац мученички од Господа примише 523. год.» — the same year exactly. «беше му 95 година када пострада», ninety-five years old when he suffered, is AN AGE and may not be subtracted from the death year to make a birth. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND THE COMPANY IS COUNTED. He suffered WITH MORE THAN FOUR THOUSAND CHRISTIANS — priests, monks and nuns, citizens, women and children. The land is ОМИРИТСКА, southern Arabia, ruled then by a Jew ДУНААН, a wicked persecutor of Christians. AND THE CITY FELL BY AN OATH: Dunaan besieged Nagran, the citizens shut the gates and his attacks on the walls failed for a long time, SO HE SWORE TO THEM THAT HE WOULD DO THEM NO HARM IF THEY WOULD ONLY OPEN AND LET HIM TAKE THE TRIBUTE THEY OWED HIM, AND WOULD THEN WITHDRAW AT ONCE. The Christians believed him and opened the gates; and the perjured man called the elder Aretas to him with all the clergy and the other notable citizens AND CUT THEM ALL DOWN WITH THE SWORD, and then made a terrible slaughter through the city. THE BYZANTINE EMPEROR JUSTIN, hearing of it, grieved and WROTE TO ELESBAAN THE EMPEROR OF ETHIOPIA to march on Dunaan and avenge the innocent blood; Elesbaan obeyed, beat him, destroyed his whole army and put him to the sword. AFTERWARDS, BY DIVINE REVELATION, A PIOUS MAN АВРАМИЈЕ WAS MADE PRINCE OF THE HOMERITES AND, AGAIN BY DIVINE REVELATION, ST ГРИГОРИЈЕ ARCHBISHOP — the entry even cross-references its own book, «в. 19. децембар». AND AT NAGRAN THE CHRISTIANS REBUILT THE CHURCH OF THE HOLY TRINITY WHICH DUNAAN HAD BURNED, AND RAISED A CHURCH TO ST ARETAS AND THE OTHER MARTYRS OF NAGRAN. FOUR PEOPLE NAMED AND NONE GETS A FOLDER, WHICH IS RULING 3. Дунаан the persecutor and the emperor Јустин are named and neither is a saint of this corpus. Аврамије, made prince of the Homerites: no folder holds him. Св. Григорије, made archbishop of the Homerites and referred to his own day: THE CORPUS HOLDS NO GREGORY ON 19 DECEMBER AT ALL — every Gregory folder’s attestations were walked and none has a feast on that day — so the one person this entry points the reader at by date is a person this corpus does not keep, and he is named here instead. No new `related`: `elesbaan-of-ethiopia`, `syncletica-of-nagran` and `holy-woman-and-her-infant` are already on this folder both ways, and the four thousand are a number and not an enumeration. No `locations`: Nagran, the land of the Homerites and southern Arabia are named and none is a coordinate. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Арета», and the day’s FOURTH entry gives the same forename with a by-name, «Арета Печерски», so the two do not collide. THE DAY’S THIRD ENTRY IS REFUSED WHOLE. It is „Свих жалосних радост.“ — the Joy of All Who Sorrow — and the entry’s own first line says what it is: «Тако се назива једна чудотворна икона Пресвете Богородице», that is the name of a wonderworking icon of the Theotokos. AN ICON IS NOT A PERSON, and section 5 refuses it as it refuses «Пренос моштију» and a «Празник»; the heading enumerates nobody. Its body names ЕФИМИЈА, sister of the patriarch ЈОАКИМ, healed at Moscow in 1688 of a grievous wound in her side after a voice told her to go to the church of the Transfiguration and have the priest pray before that icon — and both of them are refused with the entry, being in a body and not in a heading. No folder was created and nothing was written anywhere for this entry. Note that the heading’s own quotation marks are the Serbian low-9 pair the Prologue prints, and the row quoting it nests them inside the same pair, which is what section 4 asks for. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Pentru durerile Sfinţilor, care pentru Tine au pătimit, fii Mi­lostiv Doamne şi toate durerile noastre le vindecă, Iubitorule de oameni, rugămu-ne Ţie.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Areta şi al celor împreună cu dânsul. The text is a common of martyrs and names nobody.

english.text: For the sufferings of the saints who suffered for Thee, be merciful, O Lord, and heal all our sufferings, O Lover of mankind: this we ask of Thee.

hymns.text: Εὐσεβεῖα ἐμπρέπων τὴ ἀθλήσει δεδόξασαι, τὴν τῶν Χριστοκτόνων κακίαν καθελῶν τὴ ἐνστάσει σου, διὸ καὶ προσενήνοχας Χριστῷ, Μαρτύρων ἀρραγῆ συνασπισμῶν, ὥσπερ θεῖος παιδοτρίβης καὶ ὁδηγός, Ἀρέθα παμμακάριστε. Δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σοῦ, πάσιν Ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Αρέθας ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας» — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’. Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης

english.text: Comely in godliness, you were glorified in the contest, pulling down by your firm stand the malice of those who killed Christ; and so you brought to Christ an unbreakable shield-wall of martyrs, like a divine trainer and guide, all-blessed Arethas. Glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Εὐφροσύvης πρόξεvος ἡμῖν ἐπέστη, ἡ φωσφόρος σήμερον, τῶν Ἀθλοφόρων ἑορτή, ἢv ἀvυμvοῦvτες δοξάζομεv, τὸν ἐv ὑψίστοις ὑπάρχοντα Κύριον.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιος Αρέθας ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας» — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον; a common of martyrs, naming no saint, printed under his name (copied as the page prints it, Latin v for ν and all)

english.text: The light-bearing feast of the prize-winners has come to us today as the bringer of gladness; and hymning it we glorify the Lord who is in the highest.

hymns.text: Мужествовавше во Христе противу безбожнаго царя,/ мученицы святии,/ и того неверие иудейское во Христа обличивше,/ прияша мук томление и главам усечение;/ тем восхвалиша тя Ангели,/ и верных роди тя прославляют, Арефо,/ и пострадавших с тобою,/ яко молящихся присно о душах наших.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Арефы и с ним 4299 мучеников»

english.text: Having played the man in Christ against a godless king, holy martyrs, and having convicted his Jewish unbelief in Christ, you accepted the wearing down of torments and the cutting off of your heads; and so the angels praised you, and the generations of the faithful glorify you, Arethas, and those who suffered with you, as those who pray always for our souls.

hymns.text: Веселия ходатай нам наста/ светоносный днесь страстотерпец праздник,/ егоже совершающе, славим в Вышних сущаго Господа.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Арефы и с ним 4299 мучеников»

english.text: An advocate of gladness has come to us today, the light-bearing feast of the passion-bearers; and keeping it, we glorify the Lord who dwells in the highest.

death.note: The Russian calendar gives a year where the Greek one gave only a reign, and the two do not disagree: days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 24 октября ст. ст. «(523)», which falls inside the reign saint.gr dates the suffering to — «Ήταν ένας από τους προύχοντες της πόλεως Νεγράς στην Αιθιοπία επί εποχής Ιουστίνου (518 - 527 μ.Χ.)» — so the precise year is taken and the reign is recorded here rather than kept as the bounds. The Russian life itself says only «пострадали за Господа Иисуса Христа в VI веке». Read 4 October 2026.
